observations: Photo 0 shows a blue plastic water drum with a round lid and a small red bung/cap on top.
Photo 0 has visible printed markings on the drum body (partially readable), including what looks like a capacity/weight line.
Photo 1 shows the same blue drum from a different angle; lid appears intact and seated.
No visible cracks or leaks are shown in either photo, but the photos do not show the full surface (especially base/underside) or any leak test.

identity.kind: plastic water drum (food-grade style) / water storage barrel

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show an empty-looking blue plastic drum with lid and top cap.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos show markings but do not clearly confirm 'food grade' or 'used only once'.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show cracks/leaks, but they cannot confirm leak-tightness or the condition of the underside/base.

risks.risk: Underside/base damage or hairline cracks not visible in the photos (common leak point).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full bottom/underside and the drum standing on a flat surface (no wobble), plus a close-up of any seams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used drum with unknown leak condition (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-tight).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket condition (top bung and lid fit) may be worn, causing slow leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lid edge and the red bung/cap showing the sealing surface; video of the bung being tightened.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing gasket/extra sealing (worst case: assume seal may not be reliable).

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be unproven; drum could have been used for non-food chemicals previously.
risks.proof: Photo of any certification/food-grade marking label on the drum (clear text) or a receipt/label close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a general water drum (worst case: not confirmed food-grade).

risks.risk: Capacity/size mismatch affects value (drums vary by liters).
risks.proof: A photo where the capacity marking is fully readable (front text/number) or a tape-measure shot of height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely size for this type until capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the capacity/weight marking so the exact liters can be read.
Send photos of the full bottom/underside and all seams (including any ring/edge joins).
Send close-ups of the lid sealing area and the red bung/cap (show the sealing surface).
If possible, share a short video of filling with water and showing no dripping after a few minutes.
response.reason: The item type is clear (a blue plastic water drum with lid), but key value drivers—leak-tightness, food-grade confirmation, and exact capacity—are not provable from the photos alone. Request the capacity marking and underside/seal proof before pricing confidently.
